title: FleetAgentOnlinePayload
description: Payload of `fleet.agent.online` version 1: an agent went online in one of the partner's services and is reporting. The envelope's `partner_id` is set to the partner the agent is attached to. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner whose service the agent is attached to, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

at.description: When the agent went online, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
